51599808.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant human pyruvate carboxylase assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: 4.2.6. Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) Analysis. The biomolecular interaction between A3-6 and PC was analyzed by SPR using the Biacore 8K system (GE Healthcare, Uppsala, Sweden) at 25 °C. Briefly, CMS sensor chip was activated by using sulfo-NHS/EDC chemistry and subsequently immobilized with the recombinant human PC protein at a concentration of 10 μg/mL in sodium acetate (pH 4.0) and then blocked with ethanolamine for 7 min. Then, A3-6 (0.975 to 15.6 μM) was added into the running buffer to measure the interaction between A3-6 and PC. Kinetic parameters were computed with Biacore evaluation software.
original_paragraph.Figure 7 caption: Figure 7. Interaction of A3-6 with PC. (A) Visualization of the PC protein. (B) Two-dimensional (2D) interaction diagram of A3-6 and PC protein. Hydrogen bonds between A3-6 and the binding pocket in the PC were identified and indicated by red lines. (C) Visualization of the binding pocket of PC with A3-6. (D) Interaction between A3-6 (0.975 to 15.6 μM) and recombinant PC protein was analyzed by SPR. (E, F) HepG2 cells were incubated with dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) or A3-6 for 1 h, and the cell lysates were obtained by CETSA to determine the stabilization of PC. (G, H) HepG2 cell lysates were incubated with DMSO or different concentrations of A3-6 in the presence or absence of Pronase E (Pronase E: pronase = 1:1500), and then PC was detected by Western blotting. (I, J) HepG2 cell lysates were incubated with DMSO or A3-6 (40 μM) in the presence of different ratios of proteinase E, and then PC was detected by Western blotting. Data are presented as the mean ± SD of at least three separate experiments, **P < 0.01, ***P < 0.001, compared with the DMSO group. n.s. not significant.
original_paragraph.Figure 7D plot: The sensorgram in Figure 7D shows the relative response over time (s) for A3-6 binding to PC at concentrations of 15.6 μM, 7.8 μM, 3.9 μM, 1.95 μM, and 0.975 μM. The KD value is indicated as 10.1 μM.
